title: Vote: update the spec wording for the geospatial type CRS parameter
summary: This is the tail of a vote on a proposal to update the wording in the spec for the CRS parameter of the geospatial types; the opening message with the details of the proposed wording is not part of the captured thread. The messages available are two binding +1 votes, from Fokko and amogh-jahagirdar, followed by the result. milastdbx closed the vote after it had been open for seven days and announced that the proposal passed, listing eight binding +1 votes (Szehon Ho, Ryan Blue, Russell Spitzer, Kevin Liu, Steven Wu, Eduard Tudenhöfner, Fokko Driesprong, Amogh Jahagirdar) and two non-binding +1 votes (Huaxin Gao, Gang Wu), with no -1 or +0 votes. Eduard Tudenhöfner then reported that he had merged the PR.

outcome.note: Passed with 8 binding +1 votes and 2 non-binding +1 votes, and no -1 or +0 votes. The PR was merged afterwards.
